gof_pvalue.note: toys: saturated Poisson LR of the fitted binned model (630 bins, constraint terms included), 198 toys from the best fit with the global observables drawn, each refitted with m_H floating

coverage.note: toys: fraction of 198 pseudo-experiments from the best fit whose MINOS 68 % interval of mu covers the generating mu

conventions.calibration: per flavour (muon, electron) under the registered names; each value is the average of the per-bin measurements over the data leptons of the Z -> ll calibration sample; scale_shift = data/MC - 1 of the lepton momentum, smear = extra relative per-lepton pT resolution in quadrature, sel_eff = tag-and-probe data/MC efficiency ratio of the full single-lepton selection
conventions.uncertainties: total and stat: symmetrized MINOS intervals (stat with the nuisances fixed at their best fit); syst: quadrature sum of the fixed-nuisance impacts
